scientific_limitations: Applies only to full single-edge subdivisions of complete and complete bipartite graphs.
Results count labeled maximal induced matchings, not unlabeled orbit classes.
The rigorous proof is all-order; computer tests are finite corroboration.
Unindexed equivalent literature remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Maximal induced matchings of complete-graph incidence families: exact polynomials and cardinality gaps
